author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: The practical effects artists at ILM were not precious about changing #StarWars props (including R2) for the shot, but even they drew the line when #GeorgeLucas made THIS suggestion. Don Bies, former ILM model supervisor and Lucasfilm archivist, explains to #AdamSavage.
title: The Time George Lucas was told NO!!!!!

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam builds a custom cabinet for his son's apartment, which gives him the opportunity to share and show his technique for making cabinet drawers! It's not rocket science, but every furniture builder has their own method and this one has served Adam well in all the shop infrastructure builds he's done over the years. 

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Josh Self
